title: Decision tree query set
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree over the coordinate set $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and alphabet $Ω$, and let $x$ assign an alphabet symbol to each coordinate. The query set of $T$ on $x$ is the set of coordinates appearing in its query trace.
